description: Creates a MusVideo project from an imported song and starts listening to the song and drafting a story for the video. Costs 6 credits (song analysis and story). Spends credits from the user's MusVideo account: before calling, tell the user the cost and get explicit confirmation in the chat. Story preparation runs in the background for a few minutes; afterwards call get_mv_progress to show the story and ask the user to approve it. Pass a fresh requestId; calling again with the same requestId returns the same project instead of a duplicate, while calling without one may create a duplicate project. MusVideo does not create sexual or adult content, content that sexualizes or targets minors, or videos depicting real public figures or celebrities; decline those requests instead of calling this tool.

requestId.description: Unique id for this request, reused on retries.

stylePrompt.description: The look, mood, setting or story idea the user wants, in their words.
